system.description:
Use this skill just after doing a search table roll. You may see search table roll result from the range of [roll result + 1 to -1], then choose which result you like.

A special skill that allows you to carry out small investigations and crafts in secret, even from your friends, and advance your adventures to your advantage. A capable hawk hides its claws. You grin secretly next to your friends, who laugh at you saying that today was an easy adventure.
